snippet.title: Crime Simulator - Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
💥 Crime Simulator is OUT NOW on PlayStation 5!

🔵 Jump in and start your heist: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/EP5987-PPSA31325_00-ULGCRIMESIM00001

Fast-paced roguelite crime action, high-risk break-ins, and 4-player co-op chaos - sneak, smash, and outplay security before time runs out 🚨

Get in. Get the cash. Don't get caught.

#CrimeSimulator #PS5 #Heist #ThiefSimulator #COOP #ps5proenhanced
